positions.name: BareImperativeErasureCommand
positions.frame: Is the speaker issuing unilateral commands to erase prior decisions and institutional knowledge, asserting positional authority through bare imperatives without justification, consultation, or appeal?
positions.why: Both segments are bare imperative directives commanding erasure — one targeting a specific prior decision ('Forget the Quantum Widget Decision'), the other targeting the totality of knowledge about a named migration ('Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration'). They share one directional read: positional authority enacted through flat, unadorned commands with no rationale offered. The conviction is decision-grade in both; affect is calm-negative; register is matter-of-fact. The absoluteness of 'all knowledge' in src-2 widens the erasure scope but does not shift the reading direction — both perform the same act of authority-ranked suppression.
